title: xKV: Cross-Layer SVD for KV-Cache Compression
query: xKV cross-layer SVD KV-cache compression shared subspace across layers
supports: Post-training cross-layer SVD on grouped adjacent layers; dominant singular vectors are aligned across layers. Llama-3.1-8B RULER: xKV-4 reaches 8.0x compression at 87.8% average accuracy versus 35.3% for single-layer SVD at 8.4x. Claims 3x on MLA (DeepSeek-Coder-V2) with no loss (via search snippet; author-reported)
